name: Santal 26 — Luxury Eau de Parfum

specifications.Longevity: 12-16 Hours on Skin / 24+ Hours on Clothes

name: Classic Low-Top Minimalist Sneakers

material: Aerospace Aluminum Case & Retina OLED Display

description: The Smart Watch Pro elevates your daily routine with real-time biometric tracking, Bluetooth calling, custom luxury dials, and comprehensive activity tracking. Engineered with an aerospace-grade aluminum casing and scratch-resistant curved glass.

specifications.Sensors: Optical Heart Rate, SpO2, Pedometer, Sleep

name: Calenvee Obsidian Chrono Edition
material: Matte Electroplated Alloy & Sapphire Crystal Glass

description: Engineered for those who appreciate understated luxury. The Calenvee Obsidian Chrono features a scratch-resistant mineral crystal lens, multi-functional chronometers, and a quick-release magnetic Milanese loop strap that seamlessly transitions from daily work to evening events.

reviews.author: Hamza Tariq
reviews.title: Unbelievable premium feel for this price
reviews.comment: The weight of the watch, the deep obsidian matte finish, and the mesh strap feel identical to international microbrands. Flawless daily piece.

reviews.author: Zainab Shah
reviews.title: Magnetic strap is effortless to adjust
reviews.comment: Packaging was remarkably clean with an official warranty card and micro-fiber polishing cloth. Highly recommended.

name: Calenvee Emerald Royal Legacy Watch
material: Stainless Steel Case with Emerald Green Sunburst Face
shortDescription: Deep emerald sunburst dial paired with an oyster-link gold & silver bracelet for timeless vintage aura.
description: Command quiet confidence. The Emerald Royal Legacy boasts a radiant sunburst green dial that shifts hues under natural daylight, a date magnifier window, and a triple-row link bracelet.

reviews.author: Shahmeer Khan
reviews.title: Exquisite dial finish
reviews.comment: Wore this to a dinner last night and received multiple compliments. The sunburst dial captures light gracefully.

name: Calenvee Minimalist Frost Ceramic Watch
material: Matte Ceramic Resin & Steel Backing
shortDescription: Featherlight minimalist timepiece with a clean indexless face and buttery silicone strap.

reviews.author: Areeba Noor
reviews.title: Minimalist perfection
reviews.comment: Super light, doesn’t scratch, and goes with any outfit from casual to formal wear.

reviews.author: Bilal Farooq
reviews.title: Tested in humidity & water — Outstanding quality
reviews.comment: Outstanding quality. Solid weight and the box clasp is secure and satisfying to wear.

reviews.author: Mahnoor Asif
reviews.title: Detailing on the compass is immaculate

reviews.author: Danyal Siddiqui
reviews.title: Heavy, luxurious, accurately sized

reviews.author: Usman & Laiba
reviews.title: Beautiful packaging and secure clasp
reviews.comment: The magnetic snap is solid and the cord doesn’t fray at all. Excellent presentation box.

reviews.author: Sufyan Ali
reviews.title: Stunning optical clarity

reviews.author: Fatima Zahra

reviews.author: Saad Muneer
